All nine bare-V rows in the sample (044, 068, 069, 206, 207, 208, 209, 210, 269) carry middle 'V', suffix null and a display_name that already places the initial, so R5-b has no applicable row. Zero labels were changed under it. It was the PARSER, not the gold, that read V as a suffix.
